name: Jock Landale
comment: Landale is out for Wednesday's game against the Wizards with a left hip strain, Kevin Chouinard of the Hawks' official site reports.

name: Jalen Johnson
comment: Johnson (ankle) is listed as out for Wednesday's game in Washington.

name: Asa Newell
comment: Newell won't return to Wednesday's game against the Wizards due to a left great toe hyperextension, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports. He'll finish with two points (1-1 FG), three rebounds and three assists across 10 minutes.

name: Mouhamed Gueye
comment: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

name: Henri Veesaar
comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

name: Jayson Tatum
comment: Tatum will be rested Wednesday against the Bucks, Jack Simone of BostonSportsJournal.com reports.

name: Payton Pritchard
comment: Pritchard exited Wednesday's 109-102 win over the Bucks and did not return due to a right eye abrasion, finishing with 10 points (4-7 FG, 2-2 FT), five assists and one rebound across 18 minutes.

name: Devin Carter
comment: Carter (illness) practiced with the G League's Maine Celtics on Wednesday.

name: Noah Clowney
comment: Clowney (knee) supplied seven points (3-6 FG, 1-4 3Pt), one rebound and one assist over 17 minutes during Wednesday's 114-104 victory over the Hornets.

name: Day'Ron Sharpe
comment: Sharpe registered 15 points (5-7 FG, 1-1 3Pt, 4-5 FT), 13 rebounds and four assists across 26 minutes in Sunday's 98-90 win over the Pacers.

name: Egor Demin
comment: The Nets exercised Demin's third-year team option for the 2027-28 season, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports Thursday.

name: Tyler Bilodeau
comment: Bilodeau (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Indiana.

name: Kon Knueppel
comment: Knueppel exited Wednesday's game against the Nets after experiencing soreness in his left leg and he will not return, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

name: Grant Williams
comment: The Hornets recalled Williams (hamstring) from the G League's Greensboro Swarm on Wednesday.

name: Nic Claxton
comment: The Bulls assigned Claxton (hamstring) to the G League's Windy City Bulls on Thursday.

name: Zach Collins
comment: Collins (undisclosed) exited to the locker room in the fourth quarter of Wednesday's 135-105 loss to the Knicks, finishing with three points (1-4 FG, 0-2 3Pt, 1-1 FT), three assists, one rebound and one steal across 14 minutes.

name: Jalen Smith
comment: Smith (hand) won't return to Wednesday's game against the Knicks.

name: Peyton Watson
comment: Watson (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's game in Oklahoma City.

name: Jarrett Allen
comment: Allen (knee) exited to the locker room in the first quarter of Wednesday's 124-116 loss to the Thunder and did not return, finishing with zero points (0-1 FG) and one rebound in seven minutes.

name: Tyrese Proctor
comment: Proctor exited Wednesday's 124-116 loss to the Thunder in the fourth quarter and did not return due to an apparent ankle injury, finishing with 11 points (4-7 FG, 2-3 3Pt, 1-1 FT), one rebound and one steal across 22 minutes.

name: Jaylon Tyson
comment: According to Cavaliers head coach Kenny Atkinson, Tyson (ankle) has been "on the court lately progressing well," Chris Fedor of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.

name: Max Christie
comment: Christie (hip) is out for Wednesday's game against the Spurs.

name: Santi Aldama
comment: Aldama (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against the Spurs, Grant Afseth of DallasHoopsJournal.com reports.

name: Tarik Biberovic
comment: Biberovic (heel) is listed as out for Monday's game against Sacramento.

name: Dereck Lively II
comment: Lively (foot) is listed as out for Monday's game against the Kings.

name: Sergio de Larrea
comment: Head coach Dusty May said Friday that de Larrea (knee) will be re-evaluated next week, Noah Weber of TheSmokingCuban.com reports.

name: DeMar DeRozan
comment: DeRozan has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Raptors due to lower-back spasms.

name: Spencer Jones
comment: Jones (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's game against the Raptors.

name: Julian Strawther
comment: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

name: Isaiah Joe
comment: Joe (hip) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Philadelphia.

name: Jalen Duren
comment: Duren will be re-evaluated in two weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

name: Gui Santos
comment: Santos (knee) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Heat.

name: Kristaps Porzingis
comment: The Warriors have stopped issuing salary payments to Porzingis, who remains away from the team and is considering retirement, Anthony Slater and Shams Charania of ESPN reported Wednesday.

name: Moses Moody
comment: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

name: Jimmy Butler III
comment: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

name: Clint Capela
comment: Capela (ankle) is out for Wednesday's game against the Timberwolves.

name: Steven Adams
comment: Head coach Ime Udoka said Wednesday that Adams (calf) is still without a timetable to return and will be evaluated on a "weekly basis," Varun Shankar of the Houston Chronicle reports.

name: Kelly Oubre Jr.
comment: Oubre (calf) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Grizzlies.

name: T.J. McConnell
comment: McConnell (hamstring) is out for Monday's game against the Hawks and remains week-to-week.

name: Johnny Furphy
comment: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

name: Ben Sheppard
comment: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

name: Tyrese Haliburton
comment: Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least the next two weeks of action, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
comment: The Clippers recalled Niederhauser (foot) from the G League's San Diego Clippers on Sunday.

name: Brandon Ingram
comment: The Clippers recalled Ingram (Achilles) from the G League's San Diego Clippers on Sunday.

name: Bradley Beal
comment: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

name: Jordan Miller
comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

name: Adou Thiero
comment: The Lakers assigned Thiero (knee) to the G League's Coachella Valley Lakers on Wednesday, per Khobi Price of The California Post.

name: Isaiah Stewart
comment: Stewart (knee) exited Wednesday's 107-103 loss to the Pacers and did not return, finishing with six points (3-4 FG) and one rebound in 10 minutes.

name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
comment: Pippen (back) won't play Wednesday against the Pacers.

name: Kam Jones
comment: Jones (ankle) won't play Wednesday in Boston.

name: Terrence Shannon Jr.
comment: Shannon (hip) is out for Wednesday against the Rockets.

name: Anthony Edwards
comment: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

name: Donte DiVincenzo
comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

name: Trey Murphy III
comment: Murphy (knees) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against Utah.

name: Yves Missi
comment: Missi (knee) won't play in Saturday's game against Atlanta.

name: Josh Hart
comment: Hart is out for Wednesday's game against the Bulls due to right ankle soreness.

name: Jaylin Williams
comment: Williams (back) is listed as out for Wednesday's game versus Cleveland, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

name: Nikola Topic
comment: Topic (back) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against Cleveland.

name: Thomas Sorber
comment: Sorber (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against the Cavaliers.

name: Cason Wallace
comment: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

name: Chet Holmgren
comment: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

name: Jalen Williams
comment: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.

name: Jonathan Isaac
comment: Orlando recalled Isaac (knee) from the G League's Osceola Magic on Wednesday.

name: Jalen Suggs
comment: Suggs has been diagnosed with a mild bone bruise in his right knee and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Paolo Banchero
comment: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Noah Penda
comment: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

name: Izaiyah Nelson
comment: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

name: Adem Bona
comment: Bona exited Wednesday's 112-106 win over the Pistons in the fourth quarter and did not return due to an apparent head injury, finishing with five points (2-4 FG, 1-1 FT), two rebounds, one assist and one steal across 15 minutes.

name: Dominick Barlow
comment: Head coach Nick Nurse said Wednesday that Barlow (back) likely needs another 10-12 days before he's cleared to return to the court, Derek Bodner of AllPHLY.com reports.

name: Ariel Hukporti
comment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Jordan Goodwin
comment: Goodwin (calf) won't play in Wednesday's game against Portland.

name: Rasheer Fleming
comment: Fleming is out for Wednesday's game against the Trail Blazers due to a sprained left ankle.

name: Mark Williams
comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Vit Krejci
comment: Head coach Micah Nori said that Krejci suffered a left leg fracture during Wednesday's 132-119 win over the Suns, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

name: Ja Morant
comment: Morant has been diagnosed with a Grade 2 left hamstring strain and is expected to miss four weeks, Portland announced Friday.

name: Shaedon Sharpe
comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Daeqwon Plowden
comment: Plowden (illness) is out for Wednesday's game against the Lakers.

name: Maxime Raynaud
comment: Raynaud (knee) is progressing in his rehabilitation and will be re-evaluated in approximately two weeks, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

name: Keegan Murray
comment: Murray (ankle) will be re-evaluated in 10-to-14 days, NBA reporter Marc Stein reports.

name: Ben Simmons
comment: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

name: Tobias Harris
comment: Harris (calf) is listed as out for Saturday's game against Minnesota.

name: Jayden Quaintance
comment: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

name: Kawhi Leonard
comment: Leonard has completed treatment to reduce swelling in his left knee and he will be re-evaluated in one week, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

name: Nate Bittle
comment: Bittle (foot) is out for Monday's game against the Clippers and remains without a timetable to return.

name: Jusuf Nurkic
comment: Nurkic (foot) is out for Wednesday's game against the Pelicans.

name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
comment: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Trey Alexander
comment: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

name: Reece Beekman
comment: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

name: Tristan Vukcevic
comment: Vukcevic (hip) is listed as out for Monday's game against Orlando.

name: Justin Champagnie
comment: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

name: Jamir Watkins
comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
